data.title: 久远寺有珠 · 潮池里的玻璃魔法
data.description: 【海边岩池·午后】有珠穿着深蓝色泳装与长罩衫，坐在潮池边用玻璃瓶收集发光海藻；她把瓶子举向阳光，海水在黑发旁闪烁，嘴角出现几乎看不见的满意弧度。
data.action: 岩池边举起发光海藻玻璃瓶观察，嘴角浮起几乎看不见的满意
data.lighting: clear afternoon beam on blue water
data.mood: 把海边也变成安静的魔术工房
data.promptProse: Alice Kuonji sits beside the rocky tide pool in a deep-blue one-piece and long dark cover-up with a shell clasp. After collecting luminous seaweed, she raises the clear glass jar into the sun with a barely visible satisfied smile. The horizontal medium view includes submerged rock shelves and blue water behind. Afternoon light passes through the jar and seaweed, making colored reflections on her fingers and sharp wet highlights across the pool edge.
